name: yq6h24-aqua-claude
goal: Preserve MB2's active sessions while new Claude launches use the Aqua keychain, refuse a signed-out pane, and prove a launcher-started Haiku reply

evidence: MB2 Aqua direct and Aqua-owned tmux report subscription, while the existing SSH-owned claude server reports signed out. Keep legacy panes and route new MB2 Claude launches through a separate Aqua socket.

Existing managed-worker and foreground scenarios cover signed-out preflight and first-run onboarding. Their tmux fixture does not distinguish sockets, and no screen fixture represents successful preflight followed by the locked-keychain pane. Extend the same worker roundtrip and foreground rejection assertions for both gaps.
